WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.district_id AS d, di.A3 AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM account a JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, di.A3),
s2 AS (SELECT r, AVG(c) AS av FROM s1 GROUP BY r),
s3 AS (SELECT s1.d AS d, s1.r AS r, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.av AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.r = s2.r WHERE s1.c > s2.av),
s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM s3),
s5 AS (SELECT s3.c * 1.0 / s4.av AS ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT s3.d, s3.r, s3.c, s3.diff, s3.c * 1.0 / s4.av AS ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c * 1.0 / s4.av >= (SELECT MIN(ratio) FROM s5) ORDER BY ratio DESC
